transcript.content: Hi, I’m glad you came in today. What brings you in?

Well, what brings me in is... I've been having this issue where once I start eating at night, I just can't seem to stop. It feels like I can almost see myself doing it, and I'm telling myself to stop, but my hands just keep going back for more.
When these nighttime eating episodes happen, are you fully awake?

Yeah, I'm completely awake. I'm not sleepwalking or anything like that. I'm wide awake and... well, I know exactly what I'm doing. Like I said, I'm telling myself to stop the whole time, so I'm definitely conscious. I just don't seem to have the control to actually stop.
During these episodes, do you eat an unusually large amount of food?

Yeah, I do. Some evenings I’ll start with just some leftovers, but then... I end up eating sandwiches, cereal, cookies, really whatever snack food is in the pantry. It's far more than I would ever put on a plate for a normal supper.
After these episodes, do you ever make yourself vomit?
No, I don't do that. I've never tried to make myself throw up or anything like that. I just... well, I just sit there feeling completely stuffed.
After these episodes, do you ever try to compensate for the eating by fasting, exercising a lot, or using laxatives or diuretics?

Yeah, I do. I don't use laxatives or pills or anything like that, but... well, after a bad eating night, I’ll tell myself I’m making up for it by skipping breakfast and lunch the next day. Or I'll go out walking and push myself miles past my usual route, even when my knees are aching and telling me I really should just head home. I just feel like I have to balance it out somehow.
During these eating episodes, do you feel unable to control how much you eat?

Yeah, I do. Honestly, that's a big part of what brings me in. Once I start eating at night... it's almost like I can see myself doing it, and I'm in my head telling myself to stop, but my hands just keep going back for more. I just can't seem to stop once I get going.
How often do these nighttime eating episodes happen?

Well, for the last several months, I'd say most weeks have had at least one night where I eat like that. And then, you know, I spend the whole next day trying to make up for it... skipping meals, telling myself I'm only allowed certain foods, or pushing myself on one of those extra-long walks.
How much does your body shape or weight affect how you feel about yourself as a person?

It affects me quite a bit, honestly. I used to judge my day by whether I solved a tough design problem at work, or... or if I helped out at the theater. That was how I measured my worth. But lately, it's different. I just look at my stomach in the mirror, and I feel like the whole measure of who I am comes down to whether I look controlled or just sloppy.
For the past 3 months, have these eating episodes followed by trying to make up for them been happening at least once a week?

Yeah, that's right. Like I mentioned, for the last several months, I'd say most weeks have had at least one night where I eat like that. And then I spend the next day trying to make up for it... you know, skipping meals, setting strict rules about what I can eat, or pushing myself on an extra-long walk. It's been pretty consistent like that.
